questions.prompt: When was the last time you went to a theatre?
questions.sampleA1: I go theatre. Last year. I see show.
questions.sampleA2: I went to the theatre last year. I saw a movie. It was good and I liked it. I went with my family.
questions.sampleB1: The last time I went to a theatre was maybe six months ago. I think it was to see a musical with my friend. It was quite good, actually. I don't go very often, but I do enjoy it when I do. The tickets are usually quite expensive, though.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, it's been a while — probably about six months ago. I went to see a comedy play with a couple of friends, and we had a great time. There's something special about a live performance that films just can't match. I don't go all that often, but I always come away glad I did.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men teatrga boraman. O'tgan yili. Men tomosha ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men teatrga o'tgan yili borganman. Men kino ko'rdim. U yaxshi edi va menga yoqdi. Men oilam bilan borganman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Oxirgi marta teatrga borganimga taxminan olti oy bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin. O'ylashimcha, do'stim bilan birga musical ko'rishga borgandim. Aslida, juda yaxshi edi. Men unchalik tez-tez bormayman, lekin borganimda rohatlanaman. Lekin, chiptalar odatda juda qimmat bo'ladi.
questions.uzSampleB2: O'ylab ko'ray... Teatrga oxirgi marta taxminan bir yil oldin borganman. Men Shekspir pyesasining zamonaviy moslashuvini ko'rish uchun borgan edim. Klassik asarlarni yanada ommabop qilishga qaratilgan harakatni qadrlasam ham, bu muayyan talqindan to'liq qoniqmadim. Aktyorlik mahorati kuchli edi, ammo umumiy konsepsiya biroz sun'iydek tuyuldi. Rostini aytsam, men odatda an'anaviyroq sahnalashtirishlarni afzal ko'raman.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - When was the last time you went to a theatre?
idioms: steal the show - "barchaning e'tiborini o'ziga qaratmoq (qoyil qoldirmoq)"
bring the house down - "zalni qarsaklar bilan portlatmoq (katta olqishga sazovor bo'lmoq)"
music to my ears - "qulog'imga yoqadigan musiqa (xushxabar bo'lsa-da teatrdagi ohangdorlikni ham anglatishi mumkin)"
sentenceStarters: "The last time I visited a theatre was about three months ago to…" - "Mening teatrga oxirgi marta borganim bundan qariyb uch oy oldin … uchun bo'lgan."
"Honestly, there's a unique magic to live theatre that cinema…" - "Rostini aytsam, jonli teatr o'ziga xos shunday sehrga egaki, uni kino…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
The last time I visited a theatre was about three months ago to watch a highly anticipated classical play. The live performance was absolutely captivating, and the atmosphere inside the grand auditorium was electrifying.
Honestly, there's a unique magic to live theatre that cinema simply cannot replicate. Seeing the actors' raw emotions up close truly stole the show and left a lasting impression on me.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Oxirgi marta teatrga taxminan uch oy oldin, juda kutilgan klassik pyessani tomosha qilish uchun borgan edim. Jonli ijro juda hayratlanarli edi va katta zal ichidagi atmosfera elektrlashtiruvchi edi.

Rostini aytsam, jonli teatrda kinoda takrorlab bo'lmaydigan o'ziga xos sehr bor. Aktyorlarning xom hissiyotlarini yaqindan ko'rish, haqiqatan ham, tomoshani o'g'irladi va menda uzoq muddatli taassurot qoldirdi.

questions.prompt: Are there any hobbies you think are popular in your country?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. I like football. My friends too. We play.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I think football is popular. Many people watch it on TV. And some people play football in the park because it is fun.
questions.sampleB1: Yes, I think there are some popular hobbies. For example, football is very popular in my country. Lots of people play it, and also many people watch it on TV. Also, I think maybe video games are popular, especially with young people.
questions.sampleB2: Definitely. I'd say football stands out as the number one hobby — people play it everywhere and follow the local league religiously. Having said that, I've noticed that hiking and other outdoor pursuits have really taken off lately, especially since the pandemic. The thing is, people seem to value spending time in nature far more these days.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha. Men futbolni yaxshi ko'raman. Mening do'stlarim ham. Biz o'ynaymiz.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, menimcha futbol mashhur. Ko'p odamlar uni televizorda ko'rishadi. Va ba'zi odamlar parkda futbol o'ynashadi, chunki bu qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Ha, menimcha, ba'zi mashhur hobbiylar bor.
Masalan, futbol mening mamlakatimda juda mashhur. Ko'p odamlar uni o'ynaydi, shuningdek, ko'p odamlar uni televizorda tomosha qiladi. Shuningdek, menimcha, video o'yinlar ham mashhur bo'lishi mumkin, ayniqsa yoshlar orasida.
questions.uzSampleB2: Albatta, ajralib turadigan bir nechta hobbi bor. Futbol, ehtimol, eng mashhuri, chunki odamlar uni hamma joyda o'ynayotganini ko'rasiz va milliy liga juda ko'p muxlislarga ega. Biroq, men shuningdek, sayr qilish va ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlar kabi narsalar, ayniqsa pandemiya davridan beri, tobora ommalashib borayotganini sezdim. Odamlar hozirgi kunda tabiatda vaqt o'tkazishni ko'proq qadrlayotganga o'xshaydi.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Are there any hobbies you think are popular in your country?
idioms: take something by storm - "tezlik bilan juda mashhur bo'lib ketmoq (masalan, mamlakatni zabt etmoq)"
catch on - "ommaviylashmoq (urfga kirmoq)"
the name of the game - "eng asosiy narsa(maqsad)"
sentenceStarters: "Yes, without a doubt. Team sports like football are immensely popular…" - "Ha, shubhasiz. Futbol kabi jamoaviy sport turlari … juda mashhur."
"Recently, however, more solitary, tech-driven hobbies such as…" - "Biroq yaqinda keng tarqalgan ancha xilvat, texnologiyalar bilan bog'liq hobbilardan …"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Yes, without a doubt. Team sports like football are immensely popular in my country, with people of all ages either playing socially or passionately following local leagues.
Recently, however, more solitary, tech-driven hobbies such as mobile gaming and photography have rapidly gained traction among the younger generation. It seems these modern pastimes are really "taking the country by storm."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ha, shubhasiz. Futbol kabi jamoaviy sport turlari mening mamlakatimda juda mashhur, odamlar yoshidan qat'i nazar, ijtimoiy o'ynashadi yoki mahalliy ligalarni ishtiyoq bilan kuzatib borishadi.

Yaqinda esa, mobil o'yinlar va fotosurat kabi texnologiyaga asoslangan yakka hobbiylar yosh avlod orasida tez sur'atlar bilan ommalashib bormoqda. Ko'rinishidan, bu zamonaviy mashg'ulotlar haqiqatan ham "butun mamlakatni qamrab olmoqda".

questions.prompt: Do you like the transport system in your country?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. I like bus. Bus is good.
questions.sampleA2: I like the train. It is fast. But the bus is slow and sometimes late. I don't like the bus very much.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think the transport system is okay. The trains are usually on time, which is good. However, the buses are not so good. They are often delayed, and sometimes they don't come at all. So, I have mixed feelings about it.
questions.sampleB2: I've got mixed feelings, to be honest. On the one hand, the high-speed trains are brilliant — they connect the major cities quickly and run like clockwork. On the other hand, the local buses, especially out in rural areas, leave a lot to be desired. They're unreliable and few and far between, which makes life hard without a car.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga poyezd yoqadi. U tez. Lekin avtobus sekin va ba'zan kech qoladi. Menga avtobus unchalik yoqmaydi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, menimcha transport tizimi yaxshi. Poyezdlar odatda o'z vaqtida keladi, bu yaxshi.
Lekin, avtobuslar unchalik yaxshi emas. Ular ko'pincha kechikadi, ba'zida umuman kelmaydi. Shunday qilib, men bu haqda aralash his-tuyg'ularga egaman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men mamlakatimdagi transport tizimiga nisbatan biroz ikki xil fikrda bo'laman. Bir tomondan, yuqori tezlikdagi temir yo'l tarmog'i ajoyib, yirik shaharlarni samarali va qulay tarzda bog'laydi.
Boshqa tomondan, mahalliy avtobus xizmatlari, ayniqsa qishloq joylarda, ko'pincha ishonchsiz va kam uchraydi. Bu nomutanosiblik mashinasi bo'lmagan odamlarning muhim xizmatlar va imkoniyatlardan foydalanishini qiyinlashtiradi.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Do you like the transport system in your country?
idioms: an uphill battle - "qiyin kurash (og'ir vazifa)"
leave much to be desired - "qoniqarsiz (juda ham idealdan uzoq) bo'lmoq"
run like clockwork - "soatdek (juda aniq va muntazam) ishlamoq"
sentenceStarters: "Generally, our transport system is fairly reliable, especially…" - "Umuman olganda, bizning transport tizimimiz ancha ishonchli, ayniqsa…"
"However, the bus network in the suburbs leaves much to be desired. It can be…" - "Biroq, shahar atrofidagi avtobus tarmog'i ko'ngildagidek emas (ko'p narsa orzu qilishga qoldiradi). Bu…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Generally, our transport system is fairly reliable, especially the metro, which is fast and efficient for navigating the city center during rush hours.
However, the bus network in the suburbs leaves much to be desired. It can be frustratingly infrequent, meaning without a car, getting around can sometimes feel like an uphill battle. There is certainly room for improvement.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Umuman olganda, bizning transport tizimimiz ancha ishonchli, ayniqsa metro, u tirbandlik paytida shahar markazida harakatlanish uchun tez va samarali.

Biroq, shahar chetidagi avtobus tarmog'i yaxshi emas. U juda kamdan-kam bo'lishi mumkin, ya'ni mashinasiz yurish ba'zan juda qiyin bo'lishi mumkin. Albatta, yaxshilanishga joy bor.

questions.prompt: What do you see in this pictures?
questions.sampleA2:
In the first picture, I see snow and people are playing.

And in the second picture, I see a beach and the sun is shining.

I like the beach because it's hot.
questions.sampleB1:
Okay, in the first picture, I can see people enjoying winter sports in the snow. They look like they're having fun.

And in the second picture, it's a beach with people relaxing and swimming.

I think I prefer the beach because I like the sun more than the cold.
questions.sampleB2: So, both pictures are about travelling, but in totally different seasons. In the first one, a family is trekking through deep snow, all wrapped up in warm coats and woolly hats, with the snow-capped Alps towering behind them. The second picture, on the other hand, shows a family loading up their car by the coast, with a surfboard on the roof and the bright blue sea in the background — there's even a sign for Sorrento. Personally, I'm drawn to the summer scene, though the mountains do look stunning.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Birinchi rasmda qor va odamlar o'ynayotganini ko'ryapman.

Ikkinchi rasmda esa plyajni ko'ryapman va quyosh porlayapti.

Menga plyaj yoqadi, chunki u yer issiq.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, birinchi rasmda odamlar qorda qishki sport turlaridan zavqlanayotganini ko'ryapman. Ular xursandchilik qilayotganga o'xshaydi.

Ikkinchi rasmda esa, plyaj, odamlar dam olayapti va suzishyapti.

Menimcha, plyajni afzal ko'raman, chunki sovuqdan ko'ra quyoshni ko'proq yaxshi ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Birinchi rasmda qishning klassik manzarasi tasvirlangan, odamlar qor o'yinlarida faol ishtirok etmoqda. Bu juda tetiklantiruvchi va energiya bilan to'lgan muhitga o'xshaydi.

Ikkinchi rasm esa, aksincha, ancha xotirjam muhitni taqdim etadi. Unda quyoshli plyaj, odamlar dam olib, suvdan zavqlanayotgani ko'rsatilgan.

Ikkala manzara ham o'ziga xos jozibaga ega bo'lsa-da, meni ko'proq plyaj muhiti o'ziga tortadi. Dengiz bo'yida dam olish g'oyasi, odatda, sovuqqa bardosh berishdan ko'ra menga ko'proq yoqadi, garchi qorli landshaftning go'zalligini qadrlasam ham.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Describe the pictures
idioms: dog days of summer - "yozning jazirama (eng issiq) kunlari"
soak up the sun - "quyoshda toblanmoq (quyosh nuridan bahra olmoq)"
chill to the bone - "suyakkacha muzlatib yubormoq garchi bu yerda aksincha ishlatilgan bo'lsa ham"
sentenceStarters: "The first picture shows people wrapped in thick, warm clothing…" - "Birinchi rasmda qalin, issiq kiyimlarga o'rangan holda … qilayotgan odamlar ko'rsatilgan."
"In contrast, the second image depicts a classic summer getaway…" - "Aksincha, ikkinchi rasmda klassik yozgi ta'til tasvirlangan…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
The first picture shows people wrapped in thick, warm clothing, enthusiastically engaging in winter sports. They are playing in the snow, surrounded by a frozen, picturesque landscape.
In contrast, the second image depicts a classic summer getaway. People are relaxing leisurely on a sun-drenched beach, wearing swimwear, and soaking up the tropical atmosphere. The two images perfectly contrast the bracing thrill of winter with the lazy "dog days" of summer vacations.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi rasmda qalin, issiq kiyimlarga o'ralgan, qishki sport turlari bilan ishtiyoq bilan shug'ullanayotgan odamlar tasvirlangan. Ular qorda o'ynashmoqda, muzlagan, go'zal manzara bilan o'ralgan.

Aksincha, ikkinchi rasmda klassik yozgi dam olish tasvirlangan. Odamlar quyosh nurlari tushgan plyajda bemalol dam olishmoqda, suzish kiyimlarini kiyishgan va tropik muhitdan bahramand bo'lishmoqda. Ikki rasm qishning tetiklantiruvchi hayajonini yozgi ta'tilning dangasa "issiq kunlari" bilan mukammal tarzda qarama-qarshi qo'yadi.

questions.prompt: What advantages are there for people travelling in summer?
questions.sampleA1: Summer is good. The sun is hot. I like the beach in summer.
questions.sampleA2: I like summer travel. It's warm, and I can swim. I can go to the beach and eat ice cream. It's fun!
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think travelling in summer is good because the weather is usually nice. For example, you can go swimming and sunbathe. Also, there are usually more festivals and outdoor events happening. However, it can be more crowded and expensive.
questions.sampleB2: Well, the biggest advantage has to be the weather — it's reliably warm, so you can pack light and make the most of being outdoors. On top of that, the days are much longer, which gives you more time to explore. And summer is packed with festivals and lively nightlife, so there's always a buzz in the air.
questions.uzSampleA1: Yoz yaxshi. Quyosh issiq. Menga yozda plyaj yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men yozda sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko'raman. Ob-havo iliq va men suzishim mumkin. Men plyajga borib, muzqaymoq yeyishim mumkin. Bu qiziqarli!
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, menimcha yozda sayohat qilish yaxshi, chunki ob-havo odatda yaxshi bo'ladi.
Masalan, siz suzishingiz va quyoshda toblanishingiz mumkin. Shuningdek, odatda ko'proq festivallar va ochiq havoda tadbirlar bo'lib o'tadi.
Biroq, odamlar ko'proq bo'lishi va narxlar qimmatroq bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2: Yozda sayohat qilishning bir qancha afzalliklari, albatta, bor. Birinchidan, ob-havoning barqaror yaxshi bo'lishi ochiq havoda ko'proq mashg'ulotlar o'tkazish imkonini beradi va sayohatdagi uzilishlar xavfini kamaytiradi. Ikkinchidan, ko'plab manzillar uzoqroq ochilish soatlarini va maxsus yozgi tadbirlarni taklif etadi, bu esa yanada boy madaniy tajriba beradi. Bundan tashqari, yoz ko'pincha maktab ta'tillari bilan mos keladi, bu esa oilalarga birgalikda sayohat qilish va unutilmas xotiralar yaratish uchun ideal vaqtdir.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - Advantages of summer travel
idioms: let one's hair down - "sochini yoymoq (erkin his qilib, maroq bilan dam olmoq)"
travel light - "yengil (kam yuk bilan) sayohat qilmoq"
make hay while the sun shines - "quyosh chiqib turganda pichan o'rib ol (vaziyat qulayligida fursatdan foydalan)"
sentenceStarters: "Traveling during the summer offers numerous compelling advantages. Foremost, the weather…" - "Yoz faslida sayohat qilish bir qator jozibador afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Avvalo, ob-havo…"
"Additionally, summer translates to longer daylight hours. Travelers can…" - "Qo'shimchasiga, yoz kun yorug'ining uzoqroq bo'lishini anglatadi. Sayohatchilar … mumkin."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Traveling during the summer offers numerous compelling advantages. Foremost, the weather is dependably pleasant, which means tourists can pack significantly lighter luggage without needing bulky coats and boots. This makes spontaneous exploration much easier.
Additionally, summer translates to longer daylight hours. Travelers can maximally utilize their days, spending more time outdoors visiting historical sights or simply lounging on the beach until late evening.
Finally, summer naturally coincides with vibrant cultural festivals and bustling nightlife. The general mood of locals and tourists alike is undeniably more cheerful, making it the perfect time to "let your hair down" and socialize.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Yozda sayohat qilish ko'plab jozibali afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Avvalo, ob-havo ishonchli darajada yoqimli bo'ladi, bu esa sayyohlar katta paltolar va etiklar kerak bo'lmagani uchun ancha yengil yuklarni yig'ishlari mumkin degani. Bu esa o'z-o'zidan paydo bo'lgan tadqiqotlarni ancha osonlashtiradi.

Bundan tashqari, yoz uzoqroq kunduzgi soatlarni anglatadi. Sayohatchilar o'z kunlaridan maksimal darajada foydalanishlari, ko'proq vaqtni ochiq havoda tarixiy joylarni ziyorat qilish yoki shunchaki kechgacha plyajda dam olish bilan o'tkazishlari mumkin.

Nihoyat, yoz tabiiy ravishda jonli madaniy festivallar va gavjum tungi hayot bilan birga keladi. Mahalliy aholi va sayyohlarning umumiy kayfiyati shubhasiz ko'tarinki bo'ladi, bu esa "dam olish" va muloqot qilish uchun ayni muddao.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer travelling in winter?
questions.sampleA1: I like winter. Some people like snow. They go to the mountains.
questions.sampleA2: I think some people like winter travel because they like snow. And they can do skiing. But I don't like cold weather very much.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some people prefer travelling in winter because they enjoy winter sports like skiing or snowboarding. Also, it's often less crowded than in the summer, so you can see the sights without lots of tourists. For example, visiting a Christmas market is a nice experience. However, I personally prefer warmer weather.
questions.sampleB2: I suppose the main draw is winter sports — skiing and snowboarding are a huge pull for a lot of people. On top of that, popular destinations are far less crowded, so you can beat the crowds and enjoy things at your own pace. And let's be honest, there's a cosy charm to festive markets and log fires that summer just can't offer.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men qishni yaxshi ko'raman. Ba'zi odamlar qorni yaxshi ko'radilar. Ular tog'larga boradilar.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, ba'zi odamlar qishda sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko'radilar, chunki ular qorni yaxshi ko'radilar. Va ular chang'i uchishlari mumkin. Lekin men sovuq ob-havoni unchalik yoqtirmayman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi odamlar qishda sayohat qilishni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki ular chang'i yoki snoubord kabi qishki sport turlarini yoqtirishadi. Bundan tashqari, odatda yozga qaraganda odam kamroq bo'ladi, shuning uchun siz diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'plab sayyohlarsiz ko'rishingiz mumkin. Misol uchun, Rojdestvo bozoriga tashrif buyurish yaxshi tajriba. Biroq, men shaxsan iliqroq ob-havoni afzal ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Ba'zi odamlarning qish oylarida sayohat qilishni afzal ko'rishlarining bir nechta sabablari bor.
Birinchidan, qishda chang'i uchish, snoubord va muzga tirmashish kabi yilning boshqa vaqtlarida mavjud bo'lmagan noyob imkoniyatlar mavjud.
Ikkinchidan, qishda ko'plab joylar odamlar bilan kamroq gavjum bo'ladi, bu esa yanada xotirjam va haqiqiy sayohat tajribasini ta'minlaydi.
Nihoyat, qish fasli o'ziga xos jozibaga ega bo'lishi mumkin, bayramona bozorlar va ba'zi sayohatchilarga yoqadigan qulay muhit bilan.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Preference for winter travel
idioms: off the beaten track - "taptalmagan yo'ldan yurmoq (sayyohlar kam boradigan joylarga qatnamoq)"
beat the crowds - "olomonni yengmoq (odamlar ko'payishidan oldin borish orqali tiqilinchdan saqlanmoq)"
a winter wonderland - "qishki mo'jizalar mamlakati (qorli ajoyib muhit)"
sentenceStarters: "There are several reasons why some individuals actively seek out winter…" - "Ba'zi odamlarning faol ravishda qishki … ni qidirishiga bir nechta sabablar bor."
"Furthermore, winter travel often allows people to escape the…" - "Bundan tashqari, qishki sayohat ko'pincha odamlarga … dan qochish imkonini beradi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are several reasons why some individuals actively seek out winter destinations. Primarily, it is the allure of winter sports. Skiing, snowboarding, and ice-skating are exhilarating activities that are strictly dependent on snow-covered, mountainous terrains.
Furthermore, winter travel often allows people to escape the suffocating crowds associated with summer tourism. Visiting iconic European cities during the off-season guarantees a more authentic and peaceful experience, not to mention the added benefit of significantly cheaper accommodation.
Lastly, there is a profound cozy aesthetic attached to winter travel. After a freezing day outdoors, sitting by a roaring fireplace with hot chocolate produces an unmatched feeling of warmth and comfort.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ba'zi odamlar qishki sayohat joylarini faol ravishda izlashining bir nechta sabablari bor. Asosan, bu qishki sport turlarining jozibasidir. Chang'i uchish, snoubord va konkida uchish - bu qor bilan qoplangan, tog'li hududlarga qat'iy bog'liq bo'lgan hayajonli mashg'ulotlardir.

Bundan tashqari, qishki sayohat odamlarga yozgi turizm bilan bog'liq bo'lgan bo'g'uvchi olomondan qochishga imkon beradi. Yevropaning mashhur shaharlariga mavsumdan tashqari tashrif buyurish yanada haqiqiy va tinch tajribani kafolatlaydi, arzonroq turar joyning qo'shimcha afzalliklarini aytmasa ham bo'ladi.

Nihoyat, qishki sayohatga chuqur shinam estetik bog'langan. Muzdek havoda ochiq havoda bir kun o'tkazgandan so'ng, olov yoqilgan kamin yonida issiq shokolad bilan o'tirish misli ko'rilmagan iliqlik va qulaylik hissini beradi.

questions.prompt: Can you describe a book or movie that impressed you?
questions.sampleA1: I like movie. Movie is good. I like action. It's fun.
questions.sampleA2: I like the movie. It's a cartoon. It's about animals and they are friends. I like it because it is funny.
questions.sampleB1: I was impressed by the book 'The Hunger Games'. It's about a girl who has to fight for her life. I think it's a really exciting story, and it also shows how unfair society can be. The main character is very brave, and I admired her a lot.
questions.sampleB2: Right, so a film that really left a lasting impression on me was 'Interstellar'. To be honest, I went in expecting just another space film, but it completely blew me away. On the surface, it's about a group of astronauts searching for a new home for humanity, but at its heart, it's a moving story about a father's love for his daughter. The visual effects were absolutely breathtaking, and the science behind it — all the stuff about time bending near a black hole — genuinely made my head spin. I came out of the cinema thinking about it for days. As for why stories have such a strong hold on us, I think it comes down to empathy. When we follow a character through their ups and downs, we can't help but put ourselves in their shoes. A dry list of facts goes in one ear and out the other, but a gripping story sticks with you because you actually feel it. Our brains seem to be wired to connect with narratives. And that's exactly how books and films can change people's opinions. By showing you the world through someone else's eyes, they quietly chip away at your prejudices. A powerful film about, say, refugees or people living in poverty can open your eyes to a reality you'd never given a second thought to. The thing is, once you've been moved emotionally, it's very hard to go back to your old way of thinking. So yes, a well-told story can genuinely shift the way you see the world.

bulletPoints: Can you describe a book or movie that impressed you?
Why do stories influence people so much?
How can books or movies change people's opinions?
questions.sampleAnswer:
A movie that impressed me:
A movie that left a profoundly deep impression on me was 'Interstellar'. Specifically, I was captivated by its breathtaking visual effects and a complex, scientifically accurate narrative involving time dilation. Beyond the science, however, it possessed a deeply emotional core focusing on a father's love for his daughter. Its mind-bending plot was truly "out of this world."
Why stories influence people:
Stories influence us immensely because human brains are biologically wired to engage with narratives. Compelling character arcs trigger empathy, making abstract concepts deeply relatable. When we witness characters overcoming adversity, we subconsciously mirror their emotions, which makes the moral of the story resonate far more powerfully than a dry recitation of facts.
How books/movies change opinions:
Media can fundamentally shift opinions by offering a first-hand perspective into a different reality. If a movie accurately portrays the struggles of marginalized communities, viewers are temporarily forced to "walk a mile in their shoes." By dismantling stereotypes emotionally, a powerful book or film can single-handedly shatter ignorance and permanently alter a person's worldview.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Menga ta'sir qilgan film:

Menga juda chuqur ta'sir qoldirgan film bu "Interstellar" bo'ldi. Ayniqsa, uning hayratlanarli vizual effektlari va vaqtning sekinlashishi bilan bog'liq bo'lgan murakkab, ilmiy jihatdan to'g'ri hikoyasi meni o'ziga tortdi. Biroq, fandan tashqari, unda otaning qiziga bo'lgan muhabbati haqida chuqur hissiy asos bor edi. Uning aql bovar qilmas syujeti haqiqatan ham "ajoyib" edi.

Nega hikoyalar odamlarga ta'sir qiladi:

Hikoyalar bizga juda katta ta'sir qiladi, chunki inson miyasi biologik jihatdan hikoyalar bilan bog'lanishga moslashgan. Qiziqarli personajlarning rivojlanishi hamdardlikni uyg'otadi va mavhum tushunchalarni juda yaqin qiladi. Biz qahramonlarning qiyinchiliklarni yengishiga guvoh bo'lganimizda, ongsiz ravishda ularning his-tuyg'ularini aks ettiramiz, bu esa hikoyaning axloqini quruq faktlarni aytib berishdan ko'ra ancha kuchliroq aks ettiradi.

Kitoblar/filmlar fikrlarni qanday o'zgartiradi:

Ommaviy axborot vositalari boshqa bir haqiqatga bevosita nuqtai nazarni taklif qilish orqali fikrlarni tubdan o'zgartirishi mumkin. Agar film cheklangan jamiyatlarning kurashini to'g'ri tasvirlasa, tomoshabinlar vaqtincha ularning o'rnida bo'lishga majbur bo'ladilar. Stereotiplarni hissiy jihatdan yo'q qilish orqali, kuchli kitob yoki film bir o'zi jaholatni yo'q qilishi va odamning dunyoqarashini butunlay o'zgartirishi mumkin.

questions.prompt: People should travel to other countries.
questions.sampleA1: Yes. I like travel. Travel is good. I go Spain.
questions.sampleA2: I think travel is good. I like to see new places and eat new food. It is fun, and I can learn about other cultures. But it is expensive.
questions.sampleB1: I think people should travel to other countries. It's a good way to learn about different cultures and see new things. For example, you can try new food and learn about history. However, it can be expensive, so it's not always easy for everyone.
questions.sampleB2: Well, this is a topic people tend to feel quite strongly about, and I can see where both sides are coming from. On the one hand, those in favour argue that travelling abroad acts as a real eye-opener. When you experience a foreign culture first-hand, it breaks down stereotypes and broadens your horizons in a way that no book or documentary ever could. On top of that, being thrown into an unfamiliar country forces you to think on your feet, and it does wonders for your language skills. You come back a more open-minded and confident person. On the other hand, the sceptics do have a point. For a start, international travel is far from cheap — for a lot of families, it's simply out of reach. What's more, there's the environmental side of things. Air travel pumps out a huge amount of carbon, so all this globe-trotting is taking its toll on the planet. And let's not forget that you can find plenty of beauty and culture right on your own doorstep, without ever getting on a plane. As for me, I'd say I sit somewhere in the middle. I genuinely believe travelling abroad is one of the most rewarding things you can do, and it teaches you lessons you'd never pick up at home. That said, I don't think it should be seen as some kind of must-do for everyone. At the end of the day, it's a wonderful opportunity if you can manage it, but it's certainly not the only way to grow as a person.

against: Some people prefer staying in their own country.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The prevailing sentiment that everyone should travel internationally is widely debated. Proponents fervently argue that international travel acting as a phenomenal cultural bridge. Encountering foreign customs firsthand undoubtedly demolishes stereotypes and dramatically broadens a person's perspective. Furthermore, navigating a new country acts as an unparalleled crash course in language skills, forcing travelers to "think on their feet."
Conversely, skeptics raise highly valid pragmatic concerns. They correctly observe that international tourism is an exorbitantly expensive privilege, fully inaccessible to the majority of the population. More critically, the aviation industry massively contributes to greenhouse gas emissions, meaning that frequent globe-trotting actively exacerbates the climate crisis. Additionally, exploring one's own domestic heritage can be just as enriching.
In conclusion, while international travel undeniably provides invaluable life lessons, it comes with heavy financial and ecological burdens. It is a marvelous opportunity, but it should not be considered a mandatory requirement for personal growth.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Hamma xalqaro sayohat qilishi kerak degan hukmron fikr keng muhokama qilinadi. Tarafdorlar xalqaro sayohat ajoyib madaniy ko'prik vazifasini bajarishini qizg'in himoya qiladilar. Chet el urf-odatlariga bevosita duch kelish, shubhasiz, stereotiplarni yo'q qiladi va insonning dunyoqarashini keskin kengaytiradi. Bundan tashqari, yangi mamlakatda yo'l topish til ko'nikmalarini oshirish bo'yicha misli ko'rilmagan tezlashtirilgan kurs vazifasini o'taydi va sayohatchilarni "tezkor fikrlashga" majbur qiladi.

Aksincha, skeptiklar juda asosli amaliy xavotirlarni uyg'otadilar. Ular xalqaro turizm aholining ko'pchiligi uchun butunlay imkonsiz bo'lgan haddan tashqari qimmat imtiyoz ekanligini to'g'ri ta'kidlaydilar. Eng muhimi, aviatsiya sanoati issiqxona gazlari emissiyasiga katta hissa qo'shadi, ya'ni tez-tez dunyo kezish iqlim inqirozini faol ravishda kuchaytiradi. Bundan tashqari, o'z yurtining merosini o'rganish ham xuddi shunday boyituvchi bo'lishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, xalqaro sayohat, shubhasiz, bebaho hayot saboqlarini bersa-da, u katta moliyaviy va ekologik yuklar bilan birga keladi. Bu ajoyib imkoniyat, lekin uni shaxsiy o'sish uchun majburiy talab deb hisoblamaslik kerak.
